tools: GitHub CLI (gh), signed in, for merged pull requests and their descriptions; without it the notes are built from the commit log alone

presentation.name: Prepare release notes from what actually shipped
presentation.summary: Builds release notes from the commits, pull requests and tickets in the release range, rewritten for the people who use the product.
benefits: Takes the version and the range from the repository, scoped to the component being released
Drops reverted, already announced and switched-off changes before they reach the notes
Puts required actions first and rewrites each change as what the user gets
Matches the heading to the released version and keeps the entry within the announcement channel's length limit
Lists what was left out and why, so omissions can be reviewed
